chunks: Abu 'Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ishaq, from Abi Basir, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:
I said: A man killed a woman. So he said: “If the woman’s family wishes to kill him, they shall pay half of his blood money and kill him; otherwise, they shall accept half of the blood money.”

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman’s family; meaning her legal heirs or entitled kin
key_terms.الدِّيَةِ: blood money; prescribed financial compensation for unlawful killing
key_terms.قَتَلَ: killed; refers to the act of homicide under legal consideration
key_terms.نِصْفَ الدِّيَةِ: half of the blood money; the compensation accepted in place of retaliation
key_terms.نِصْفَ دِيَتِهِ: half of his blood money; the amount to be paid before retaliation is carried out
key_terms.يَقْتُلُوهُ: kill him; meaning to carry out retaliatory execution (qisas)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man kills a woman in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning retaliation when a man kills a woman. It explains that the woman’s heirs may seek qisas, but if they do so, they must pay half of the man’s diyah; otherwise, they may accept half of the diyah instead.
